_meta.ground_truth_method: Regenerated by grepping every `on:` trigger across all 115 files in .claude/agents/. NOT copied from the prose table in SECTOR_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §8 — that table is where the two dead edges below were hiding.
_meta.first_of_its_kind: No *EVENT_CATALOG* file existed anywhere in this repository before this one. It was recommended in a 2026-06-03 audit and never built.
_meta.runtime_reality: CRITICAL. `emits` is DECLARATIVE METADATA ONLY. arika-runtime/src/executor.ts returns `emitted: spec.emits ?? []` but never calls eventBus.publish() and does not import the bus. Across the whole repo, `emits` is declared 196 times and published ZERO times. The only publish site is an external webhook POST (webhook-server.ts:20). Agent-to-agent event chaining DOES NOT WORK today. Everything below describes declared intent and verified subscription — not observed delivery.
_meta.subscription_mechanism: arika-runtime/src/index.ts lines 17-31 walk every loaded agent spec and call eventBus.on(t.on, ...) for each `type: event` trigger. THAT LOOP IS THE ENTIRE SUBSCRIBER REGISTRY. There is no topic registry, no broker config, no enum, no validation — spec-schema.ts declares `emits: z.array(z.string())`, so a typo binds silently to nothing.
_meta.handoff_to_is_inert: `handoff_to` frontmatter is documentation-only and is never read by index.ts. Routing happens ONLY via emits -> a subscribing agent.
